output.text: Welcome, seeker of stars, to the Sleepless Observatory—where time stands still and the heavens whisper secrets. Four sealed drawers hold fragments of a forgotten sky chart, each one a key to a celestial riddle. Before dawn breaks, you must piece them together, for the keeper awaits the return of a missing constellation. The stars are watching. Begin.
